mapper.insert: insert into pay (pay_no, request_no, order_id, amount, method, status, version, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{payNo}, #{requestNo}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, #{method}, #{status}, #{version}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update pay set request_no = #{requestNo}, method = #{method}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0
update pay set status = #{newStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = #{oldStatus}
update pay set status = #{status}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
update pay set status = #{status}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where order_id = #{orderId}
